headline: Sarepta Therapeutics Appoints Michael Severino, M.D., Chief Executive Officer
summary: CAMBRIDGE, Mass., July 27, 2026--Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:SRPT), the leader in precision genetic medicine for rare diseases, today announced the appointment of Michael Severino, M.D., as chief executive officer, effective July 28, 2026. Severino, who was previously CEO of Tessera Therapeutics, will also join Sarepta’s Board of Directors. Severino succeeds Doug Ingram, who is retiring and will serve the company in an advisory capacity until the end of 2026 to ensure a smooth transition.
